name: Astro Malaysia Holdings Berhad
overview: Astro 今年推进宽带业务资产出售给 Maxis Broadband，作价最高 RM83.0 million，并出售 Cyberjaya 物业作价 RM92 million；同时完成多家子公司自愿清盘解散，包括 Astro Arena、Astro Production Services 及 Tayangan Unggul。最新季度营收同比下滑 7.2%，净利润转亏。
overview_en: Astro this year moved to dispose of its broadband business assets to Maxis Broadband for up to RM83.0 million and sold a Cyberjaya property for RM92 million; it also completed members' voluntary winding-up and dissolution of several subsidiaries, including Astro Arena, Astro Production Services and Tayangan Unggul. Latest quarterly revenue fell 7.2% year-on-year and net profit turned to a loss.

segments.name: 电视与宽带服务
segments.note: 今年推进宽带业务资产出售，并出售 Cyberjaya 技术大楼物业。
segments.note_en: This year the segment moved to dispose of its broadband business assets and sold a technical building property in Cyberjaya.

actions.title: Circular to Shareholders in relation to the Proposed Disposal of Broadband Business Assets by MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems Sdn Bhd, a wh
actions.text: 就上述宽带业务资产出售向股东发出通函。
actions.text_en: Issued a circular to shareholders in relation to the proposed disposal of broadband business assets.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems Sdn Bhd 与 Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd 签订有条件买卖协议，出售宽带业务资产，现金代价最高 RM83.0 million。
actions.text_en: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd to dispose of its broadband business assets for a cash consideration of up to RM83.0 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述 Cyberjaya 物业出售提供补充资料。
actions.text_en: Provided additional information on the disposal of the Cyberjaya property.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems Sdn Bhd 与 AIMS Central Sdn Bhd 签订有条件买卖协议，出售位于 Cyberjaya 的 18,267 平方米商业土地及六层技术大楼等物业，现金代价 RM92 million。
actions.text_en: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with AIMS Central Sdn Bhd to dispose of a commercial land of approximately 18,267 sq.

segments.name: 内容制作与发行
segments.note: 今年完成 Astro Arena 与 Astro Production Services 的自愿清盘解散，并启动 Tayangan Unggul 的自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: This year completed the members' voluntary winding-up and dissolution of Astro Arena and Astro Production Services, and commenced the members' voluntary winding-up of Tayangan Unggul.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Astro Arena Sdn Bhd 与 Astro Production Services Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 10 月 30 日解散。
actions.text_en: Astro Arena Sdn Bhd and Astro Production Services Sdn Bhd were dissolved on 30 October 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Tayangan Unggul Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 1 月 12 日启动成员自愿清盘，该公司此前已不活跃。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Tayangan Unggul Sdn Bhd commenced a members' voluntary winding-up on 12 January 2026; the company was inactive prior to the winding-up.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟出售宽带业务资产给 Maxis Broadband，作价最高 RM83.0 million，涉及退出宽带业务资产。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed disposal of broadband business assets to Maxis Broadband for up to RM83.0 million, involving an exit from broadband business assets.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: Astro Arena 与 Astro Production Services 完成自愿清盘并于 2026 年 10 月 30 日解散。
model_changes.text_en: Astro Arena and Astro Production Services completed members' voluntary winding-up and were dissolved on 30 October 2026.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: Tayangan Unggul Sdn Bhd 启动成员自愿清盘，作为集团精简整合的一部分。
model_changes.text_en: Tayangan Unggul Sdn Bhd commenced members' voluntary winding-up as part of a group streamlining exercise.
